Name: IdaIda's Fairy seasonal Buildings (for CP and AT)
Author: idaida
Description:
[center]
[url=https://www.patreon.com/idaida][img]https://i.imgur.com/A5ZwJYT.png[/img][/url]
[color=#b4a7d6]This mod replaces the vanilla farm buildings with a super flowery cottagecore aesthetic. The colors should work well with vanilla and world recolors. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10491]
[/url]This mod includes all farm buildings and main 3 cabins. All the buildings change with the seasons.
This mod also comes in two color variations- pink and muted.



[i]All the sprites in this mod are drawn by me or repurposed vanilla sprites that are recolored by me. The bush sprite behind the Junimo hut is from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8164][color=#b4a7d6]Simple Foliage[/color][/url] by itsanette.[/i][/color]

[url=https://ko-fi.com/idaidaart][color=#9900ff]♡[/color][/url][color=#d9d2e9] [/color]

[color=#d9d2e9]My other mods: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12186][color=#8e7cc3]Gothic Buildings[/color][/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9081][color=#8e7cc3]Furniture recolor[/color][/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22501][color=#8e7cc3][b]Flooring and paths[/b][/color][/url][/color]

[color=#b4a7d6]* ˚ ✦ Combine this mod with my flooring and path mods to bring the whole farm look together * ˚ ✦[/color]

[url=https://ko-fi.com/idaidaart][color=#9900ff]♡
[/color][/url][color=#8e7cc3]Thank you to [b][url=https://forums.nexusmods.com/profile/54070902-starwishgirl/][color=#9900ff]Starwishgirl[/color][/url][/b] for kindly sharing the AT conversion[/color]
[url=https://ko-fi.com/idaidaart][img]https://i.imgur.com/9iXRwCJ.png[/img][/url]
[color=#cfe2f3][color=#cfe2f3][i]
[/i][/color][color=#cfe2f3]If you share a screenshot of your farm using my mods on the SDV Discord, please [b]ping[/b] me, I would love to see your creations![/color][/color]
[url=https://ko-fi.com/idaidaart][color=#9900ff]
♡[/color][/url]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/jOsCl4K.png[/img]﻿
